*Fall 2025 — Course Home Page*
  
Welcome to **Japan in the World Economy**.  
This course examines the structure of international trade and finance, focusing on Japan’s role in the global economy.  
Students will gain practical experience in analyzing data, reports and understanding policy impacts.
